verdict.rationale: Godot ships a documented official CLI for headless operation, running scripts, exporting, and editor automation, which supports scripted/agentic workflows. However, this CLI is a general engine command-line interface rather than one purpose-built for AI-native/agentic use cases (no AI-specific tooling, structured output, or agent-oriented commands documented). missing for 10: AI-native CLI features (structured/JSON output, agent-friendly scripting hooks, official AI tooling integration), independent hands-on validation of CLI use in agentic pipelines.
